messages:
maria: Heads-up — compact cutover planned for tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Services: runtime v2.4.1, router v1.8.0, console v3.0.0. API team will pin to runtime v2.4.1 during the window.

deploybot: Scheduled rollout created by maria. Canary policy: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 10m -> full. Health checks: error-rate < 1.5% and p99 latency within +30% of baseline. Notifications to #eng-oncall if breached.

aj: Ack. I will watch runtime CPU and KV cache miss rate during canary. If p99 > 400ms for >5m we abort and rollback.

leo: Console will hold the UI toggle for the new routing header feature behind `feature.router-prefetch=false` until final. I'll flip to true at 25% if metrics look stable.

sam: I'll update the release notes and add the known caveat for older client SDKs (they need to bump router header lib). Doing the PR now: https://git.redwood/release-notes/compact-cutover-1711456789

maria: Rollback criteria (short): 1) sustained error-rate >1.5% for 10m, 2) backend 5xx spike >3x baseline, 3) KV eviction >10% and request failures correlated. If any hit, we stop traffic and rollback runtime to v2.3.9 and router to v1.7.8.

deploybot: Preflight checks passing: infra quotas ok, reserved GPU pool available, test harness smoke passed (`smoke --env=staging --suite=interop`).

aj: Note: watch auth latency — token service had a blip yesterday. If auth p95 degrades, hold on promotion.

leo: Quick QA plan: run interactive session script + 10 synthetic user flows at 25% traffic. Ping here with results.

tj: tagging ops: will be on-call for rollback. My rollback command snippet: `deploybot rollback --service runtime --to v2.3.9 --reason "cutover-safety"` and same for router. I put the exact runbook in the deploy doc.

sam: Release notes PR opened, added migration steps for integrators and the rollback matrix. Also added a short blurb for SRE alert thresholds.

maria: timing: start canary kickoff at 02:05 UTC (5m buffer after window start). If canary healthy promote per policy. If any critical alert -> immediate stop + notify #incidents.

deploybot: Canary started at 1711457105 (02:05 UTC). Canary metrics available on console -> /dash/rollouts/1711456789.

aj: Canary health check: error-rate 0.3%, p99 +10% — watching KV miss is 2% (ok).

leo: QA flows green so far (ran at 5%). No UI regressions.

maria: Promoting to 25% now. Leo keep the toggle off until confirmed.

deploybot: Promoted to 25% at 1711457350. Monitoring window 10m.

aj: Monitoring — auth p95 stable, KV miss steady. No alerts from oncall.

maria: If all green at end of 10m we go full. Sam hold back the public docs link until final flag flip.

deploybot: 25% window passed, no abort conditions met. Proceeding to full rollout.

maria: Full rollout complete. Post-deploy checklist: 1) run load sanity (`loadcheck --rt --60s`), 2) confirm rollout notes link, 3) tag the release in changelog.

sam: Docs published and changelog tagged `release/1711456789-compact-cutover`.

tj: Closing the loop — no rollback required. Leaving a short postmortem template in #postmortems for any latency observations.

maria: Thanks everyone — great coordination. :tada:
